groups.sentence: Instructors offer practical guidance and structures for group work in courses with extensive group projects.
Instructors tell students how to respond if a group member is using AI explicitly.
Students do not use generative AI for group work unless the group mutually agrees, and then acknowledge the use.
Students list all team members who participated in the assignment.
Students discuss AI use with group members, agree on how to use it, and are transparent with the instructor.
Students are strongly discouraged from using generative AI in group work.
Group work guidelines on AI depend on the type of assignment.
All students in a group are held equally responsible for a violation.
Instructors may enroll in the Teaching and Learning with Generative AI self-paced Canvas course.
